name: Ice slope
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 2 ticks after Start.
Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone, Basalt wall, Ice slope.

Tick 1: Player moves 1 north and 1 up.
Tick 2: Player moves 1 north.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
